Opens with your fingerprint, face or the device code. Anyone who can unlock this phone can open your content. Off, the app asks for your password, never again for the Secret Key.

No entry names them, so they disappear from the pot. This can’t be undone.
A person can be deactivated or deleted once their balance is settled.

The pot’s key is being renewed. Try again in a moment.
This pot has no base currency yet. Pick one to record entries.

Every balance is in this currency. It is fixed once the first entry is saved.
Added here, they can be picked for every entry of this pot. They can be renamed, not removed.

The pot was created, its people were not. Add them in its settings.
Check the name and the people: 1 to 100 characters each.
The pot was not created. Please try again.
This entry does not add up, so it counts nowhere. Saving it corrected counts it again.
The entry keeps this rate; a later rate never changes it.
The percents add up to %1$s %%, not 100 %%.
The amounts add up to %1$s, not %2$s.
Someone else changed this entry. Here is their version; save again to put yours on top.
Blocked by the operator: this pot or entry takes no changes. Nothing was saved.
The change was not saved. Please try again.
Type an amount greater than zero, with no more decimals than the currency has.
Type the rate as a number greater than zero.
Say who paid, and how much each.
Type each percent above zero, with at most two decimals.
Type each amount above zero, with no more decimals than the currency has.
Give every item a name, an amount and its people.
What the payers paid does not add up to the amount.
What was received does not add up to the amount.
The items add up to more than the amount.
The rest is shared by no one.

The amounts of a split do not add up to what it splits.

resources.string: Deleted items wait here — with everything inside them — until the date shown. Restore one and it comes back complete.
Could not open the trash. Please try again.
Could not restore this. Please try again.
Something with a similar name already exists here.
“%1$s” and everything inside it will be permanently deleted now. This cannot be undone.
Could not delete this for good. Please try again.
Open the place it should go to and choose “Move here”. Everything inside it moves along and stays readable.
It can’t be moved into itself.
It can’t be moved into something inside it.
Nothing can be moved into a guest’s folder.
Nothing can be copied into a guest’s folder.
Move a guest’s folder out of the drop box?
“%1$s” becomes an ordinary folder: the guest who sent it can no longer add anything to it, and it cannot be moved back into the drop box. Everything in it stays readable for you.
“%1$s” could not be moved back. Please move it yourself.
Something with this name already exists there. Rename it first, or choose another place.
It can’t be placed there: that place doesn’t take this kind of item.
Someone else moved or renamed it at the same time. The view has been reloaded — please try again.
The space’s new lock is still going in. Try again in a moment.
It, or the place you chose, is no longer there.
This space is being deleted; nothing can be moved.
Moving didn’t work. Please try again.
“%1$s” was not uploaded: there is not enough storage space for it (%2$s). Free some space, or ask whoever runs your space.
“%1$s” could not be created, so nothing of it was uploaded.
The folder “%1$s” could not be created, so nothing in it was uploaded.
Replace “%1$s”? A file with this name is already here: its content is replaced by the file you picked. The old content cannot be restored: there is no version history.
“%1$s” was not uploaded: a folder, Memory or file with a similar name already exists here.
“%1$s” was not uploaded: someone else replaced this file in the meantime. Replace it anyway, or look at theirs first.
“%1$s” was not uploaded: there is no space left. Deleted files only free space once the trash is emptied.
Name — guests with the link see it

Creates a drop box with this name here. Anyone with the link can send you files: each person gets a folder of their own, and nobody sees the drop box or what others sent. You manage its links on the drop box.
Anyone with a link can add files. Nobody with it sees the drop box or what others added.
Delete this link for good? Nobody can send files with it any more. What guests already sent stays in the drop box.
The drop box is made, but its link was not. Open the drop box to make one.
Nobody has dropped anything yet. Share a link to collect files.
Open a file to download or delete it. To remove everything someone sent, delete their folder; to keep it as an ordinary folder, move it out.
“%1$s” moves to the trash with every guest’s folder in it, and its links take no files while it is there. You can restore it from the trash until it is removed for good.
“%1$s” and everything in it move to the trash. You can restore it from there until it is removed for good.
This sends a decrypted copy of “%1$s” to the app you pick. There veyq no longer protects it: that app, and wherever it syncs or forwards it, can read it.
The file could not be opened. Please try again.
This file is too large to show here. You can download it.
This file cannot be shown here. You can download it.
Showing only the first megabyte. Download the file to read all of it.
Create a link anyone can open in a browser — no account, no install. It shows only this one file, and you can switch it off anytime.
Anyone with the link can see this file and download it, read-only.
Anyone with the link can see and download this file and replace its content — the old content cannot be restored: there is no version history.
Delete this link for good? It can never be switched on or renewed again. Content guests replaced stays in this file.
Create a link anyone can open in a browser — no account, no install. It shows this folder and everything in it, and you can switch it off anytime.
Anyone with the link can look at this folder and everything in it, read-only.

Anyone with the link can look, add folders and content, move things inside this folder, and upload files — also over any file already in it, yours included. A replaced file cannot be brought back: there is no version history.
Delete this link for good? It can never be switched on or renewed again. What guests added stays in this folder.
Create a link anyone can open in a browser — no account, no install. It shows only this Pot, and you can switch it off anytime.
Your links could not be loaded.
Anyone with the link sees the entries, balances and overview, read-only.
Anyone with the link can also add, change and delete entries, and add and rename people.
Open the share only with a password (%1$d+ characters).
This space requires a password on every link (%1$d+ characters).
The link stops working after this date.
This space requires every link to end within %1$d days of the day it is made.
Your link is ready — copy it:
This space now requires a password or an end date on every link. Add what is missing and try again.
That didn’t work — please try again.
The link is switched off. What is below it gets a new lock, so the old link opens nothing that comes later either.
Tell the people who run this server about something illegal or against the terms. Only its moderators can read your report. Nobody else learns of it, the person who shared it included.
The moderators can open it and everything it holds.
The moderators can open its name and nothing else: not what it holds, not its other details.
A threat to someone’s life or safety
You do not need to give your name for this. The moderators act on your report without it.
Say what is illegal or against the terms, and why. Required.
I confirm that what I say here is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.
For a receipt now and the decision later. The server mails the receipt and keeps the address only in a form the moderators alone can read.
How your contact is kept, and for how long
Reference %1$s, received %2$s. Keep it if you want to refer to this report.
The report could not be sent. Try again.
You have too many reports that are still open. Wait until some of them are decided.
Too many reports in a short time. Try again later.
Some of what you selected cannot be read here any more, so it cannot be reported. Reload the page.
Some of what you selected is not here any more. Reload the page.
This link cannot be switched back on: someone who has left this space may still hold it. Renew it instead.
This makes a new link and deletes the old one. Hand out the new link.
Delete this link for good? It can never be switched on or renewed again. Entries guests wrote stay in the Pot.
Its password cannot be read here any more, so it cannot be renewed without losing it.
This link was already renewed or deleted — the list now shows the current links.
“%1$s” could not be downloaded. Please try again.
The picture could not be saved to the gallery.
Open the place the copy should go to and choose “Copy here”.
Shares, favourites, the trash and the original upload times. You become the owner of the copy.
The history of each entry and the deleted entries: a copy starts every entry at its current version.
A drop box becomes an ordinary folder, its people’s folders ordinary folders: no links, nobody can drop files into it, no cover.
Left out, because this version cannot copy them:
The copy did not go through. What it made was moved to the trash; please try again.
Left out, because this version cannot download them: %1$s
The copy did not go through. Nothing was left behind; please try again.
There is no free name for the copy there. Rename it first, or choose another place.
Nothing here can be copied by this version of veyq.
Upload an image as the cover, then drag and zoom to frame it.
This image could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
The cover could not be saved. Please try again.
Something with this name is already here.
The folder could not be created. Please try again.
“%1$s” and everything in it go to the trash.
